title: 0042 프로젝트 담당자 — 그 업체의 지금 구성원만(대표 · 실장 · 직원), 나간 사람 · 남의 업체 사람은 거절, 바뀔 때 assigned_at, 비우기 가능, 구성원은 못 쓴다, 승인 카드 종류 project_assign (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0042_project_assignee.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, 'staff', 'active'), ({{company_x}}, {{x_gone_user}}, 'manager', 'removed'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{cust_x}}, {{company_x}}, 'probe 고객')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title) VALUES ({{proj_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.assistant_conversations (id, company_id, user_id, title) VALUES ({{conv_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe')

checks.name: 직원을 담당자로 — 정한 때가 찍힌다
checks.sql: update public.projects set assignee_id = {{x_staff_user}}, assigned_by = {{x_owner_user}} where id = {{proj_x}}; select (assignee_id = {{x_staff_user}}) || '/' || (assigned_at is not null) || '/' || (assigned_by = {{x_owner_user}}) from public.projects where id = {{proj_x}}

checks.name: 나간 구성원은 거절
checks.sql: update public.projects set assignee_id = {{x_gone_user}} where id = {{proj_x}}

checks.name: 남의 업체 사람은 거절
checks.sql: update public.projects set assignee_id = {{y_owner_user}} where id = {{proj_x}}

checks.name: 비우기 — 담당자 없음
checks.sql: update public.projects set assignee_id = null where id = {{proj_x}}; select coalesce(assignee_id::text, 'none') from public.projects where id = {{proj_x}}

checks.name: 만들 때 대표를 담당자로 — 정한 때가 찍힌다
checks.sql: insert into public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title, assignee_id) values ({{proj_new}}, {{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe', {{x_owner_user}}); select (assigned_at is not null)::text from public.projects where id = {{proj_new}}

checks.name: 만들 때 남의 업체 사람은 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title, assignee_id) values ({{proj_bad}}, {{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe', {{y_owner_user}})

checks.name: 구성원은 담당자를 못 쓴다 (쓰기는 서버만 — 쓰기 정책이 없어 0줄)
checks.sql: update public.projects set assignee_id = {{x_staff_user}} where id = {{proj_x}}

checks.name: 승인 카드 종류 project_assign
checks.sql: insert into public.assistant_actions (id, company_id, conversation_id, user_id, kind, state, params, expect, card) values ({{act_assign}}, {{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'project_assign', 'proposed', '{"project_id":"p"}'::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb, '{"title":"t"}'::jsonb); select kind from public.assistant_actions where id = {{act_assign}}
